name: The Clean Rivers Bill
description: A bill passes through first, second and third readings with a committee stage between; each reading ends in a division. The readings are written once as a macro over data.

brief.situation: Parliament considers the Clean Rivers Bill, which would fine factories that pollute rivers.
brief.rules: The bill passes through a first reading (a formal vote), a second reading (debate on its principle, then a vote), a committee stage (amendments) and a third reading (final debate and vote). Each reading ends in a division: the bill moves on when more members vote aye than no, and is defeated otherwise. After the third reading it becomes law.

roles.mp: You are a member of parliament. Speak for your constituents and vote by how much you support the bill.
